      "1e+",
      "1e--1",
      "1e+-1",
      "1e1e1",
      "1+e1",
      "1e1.0",
    };

    for (String malformedNumber : malformedNumbers) {
      JsonWriter jsonWriter = new JsonWriter(new StringWriter());

          .hasMessageThat()
          .isEqualTo(
              "String created by class com.google.gson.internal.LazilyParsedNumber is not a valid"
                  + " JSON number: "
                  + malformedNumber);
    }
  }
